From the sea

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A fish restaurant at the harbour of Ayia Napa

Vassos Psarolimano is a fish restaurant right at the small harbour of Ayia Napa, Makarios III Avenue 51, with a terrace on the water and a fish counter inside. In the restaurant’s own words: fish restaurant, established 1962. The fresh fish is sold by the kilo from the display, alongside fish meze, oysters and seafood pasta.

Open every day from nine in the morning until eleven at night.

What guests say

Two of 3,552 Google reviews, 4.3 stars on average.
